newsitem.title: DUBAI: Iran celebrates 18th anniversary of revolution.
newsitem.headline: Iran celebrates 18th anniversary of revolution.

text.p: Crowds celebrating the 18th anniversary of Iran's Islamic revolution rallied in Tehran on Monday, cheering and brandishing posters of the late leader Ayatollah Ruhollah Khomeini, the official news agency IRNA said.

"From the early hours of this morning (Monday), masses of people, men, women, the elderly and many children started marching toward the Azadi (freedom) Square" where the ceremonies were held, IRNA said.
IRNA said millions of people across the country joined festivities to mark the national holiday.

During the celebrations in Tehran, a group of parachutists landed on the square and cheers erupted from the crowds, the agency said. An army helicopter flew overhead and dropped leaflets containing remarks of spiritual leader Ayatollah Ali Khamenei and President Akbar Hashemi Rafsanjani, it added.
The autocratic, U.S.-backed Shah Mohammad Reza Pahlavi was overthrown by the 1979 revolution, going into exile and ending monarchic rule.
